chars.HUSBAND: a young Moroccan man, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman, light pink hijab, long sage-green loose dress, visibly pregnant
chars.EX: a Moroccan woman in her early 30s, sleek dark hair bun, bright red blazer over a white blouse, gold hoop earrings
chars.WORKER: a Moroccan woman, navy blue hijab, grey office trouser suit, ID badge on a lanyard

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a cosy Moroccan living room in Casablanca with patterned cushions, HUSBAND kneels and gently puts his hand on WIFE's pregnant belly, both smiling warmly, head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible in the upper-middle of the frame

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sits alone on a Moroccan salon sofa at night, holding an old framed wedding photo and frowning at it with a bitter, thoughtful expression, lamp light, face in the upper-middle of the frame

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND reads a long message on his phone at a cafe terrace in Casablanca, raising one eyebrow, surprised and a bit annoyed, mint tea glass on the table, face in the upper-middle of the frame

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a modern office in Casablanca, EX sits at her desk with crossed arms and an arrogant smirk, ignoring her ringing phone that lies face up on the desk, face in the upper-middle of the frame

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In an open-plan Moroccan office, WORKER smiles kindly and helps a colleague with a file while EX in the background rolls her eyes, both faces visible in the upper half of the frame

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment kitchen, WORKER just home from work, still wearing her badge, laughs while unpacking groceries with her husband, a young man in a plain white t-shirt, both cheerful, faces in the upper-middle of the frame

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND and WIFE sit at a Moroccan dining table with tea, HUSBAND points his finger as if arguing a point, WIFE smiles and shrugs, a lively friendly debate, faces in the upper-middle of the frame
